description: This file defines a PHP trait 'PsrHttpFactoryHelperTrait' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\OAuth\Traits'. The trait uses another trait 'ServiceContainerTrait' and provides a protected method 'getPsrHttpFactoryHelper' which retrieves an instance of 'PsrHttpFactoryHelper' from a service container. The file is part of the OrangeHRM project, related to OAuth functionality, and serves as a helper to access HTTP factory services within the OAuth context.

methods.name: getPsrHttpFactoryHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of PsrHttpFactoryHelper from the container.
